full_text: Hello. Hello. Hi, kaise ho? Theek hoon, aap kaise? Main bhi theek hoon. Kahan se bol rahe hain aap? Patna se. Achha, main Delhi se bol rahi hoon. Aur married hain ya single hain aap? Abhi toh single hain ji. Achha, WhatsApp video calling karte hain aap? Kya charge lete hain? Hum aap matlab 300 mein 10 minute dete hain aur 600 mein aadha ghanta dete hain.
